notes.title: Epic MegaGrant
notes.notes:
I am delighted to announce that Reflect Horizons has been awarded an Epic MegaGrant. 

Massive thank you to Epic Games for their incredible generosity and support. This will not only help with the practicalities of pushing this project forward, but the confidence and self-belief that comes from having their support will be invaluable. 

At a time when funding for art projects is hard to come by, it is a real pleasure to see a games company stepping in with such unconditional support for non-gaming projects. Please keep up your amazing work. 

The follow up to Reflect Horizons is officially in the works :)
